independence_statement: Coded without reading any other screener's output. No file named screen_batch_B/C/D.* was opened, and no other screener's codes were consulted for any record, including the 15 overlap records. Full texts were fetched into a shared scratchpad that also contained files for PMIDs outside this assignment; every one of those was ignored and only the 37 records listed here were read.
access_ladder_note: screen_protocol.md section 7 rungs attempted in order: (1) PMC / publisher OA, (2) publisher site direct, (4) preprint or repository version. Rung 3 (institutional subscription) was not available to this screener and rung 5 (interlibrary loan / author request) cannot complete inside a single session, so records that failed rungs 1, 2 and 4 are coded unreachable_paywalled rather than left pending. That is the honest, and conservative, code.
coding_conventions_applied: split_unit has no 'lesion' level. Lesion-level and ROI-level splits are coded 'slice_or_image' as the nearest sub-patient image unit, with the verbatim wording preserved in split_quote (PMIDs 36776294, 31093705).

evaluation_unit mapping used consistently: a 2D object from one cross-section (slice, B-scan, frame, patch-from-slice) -> 'slice'; an explicitly named lesion/node -> 'lesion'; a 3D sub-volume smaller than the scan (vertebra, 3D crop) -> 'other'; a whole scan not aggregated to patient -> 'volume_or_scan_not_patient'.

'cases' is read as 'patients' for split_unit only where the paper's own tables give per-case demographics or one case demonstrably equals one patient (PMIDs 42130124, 36016875); both are flagged for adjudication.

For excluded records, fields that presuppose an eligible classifier are filled with the nearest not-applicable level and the quote field says so explicitly. Excluded records enter no endpoint denominator.

For unreachable records the P1 sub-flags are written false but searches_run states plainly that the mandatory full-text search was NOT run; per screen_protocol.md section 7 these records are excluded from the complete-case P1 denominator and enter the bounding analyses instead.
